evals.name: theme-only-landscape
evals.prompt: Here's a screenshot of HyperFrames Studio with my project open. Theme: Opus 5.5 uses the agentic video editor provided by HeyGen HyperFrames. This was a pleasant surprise, I did not know HeyGen had such an editor or that Opus could do this. Feels Pau Pau Powerful... Make the full post package (video with audio, Instagram Reel + Story, X, LinkedIn, captions, posting steps).
evals.expected_output: A behind-the-scenes motion video built on the real screenshot plus platform variants, stills, captions and a posting playbook, in a genuine (non-marketing) voice.
assertions: renders/post contains the four platform videos, cover_9x16/4x5, recap-card_9x16/4x5 and the original screenshot
every video is 59 s or shorter and about -14 LUFS
beats.json uses energy 'punchy' (the theme is excited) and leaves dur out
no beat about the lint/warning badge or other off-theme status
no file names, URLs or paths in on-screen text
statement and close text sits above the screenshot, not on it (landscape shot)
POSTING.md has steps and captions for Reel, Story, X and LinkedIn; each X post is 280 characters or fewer

evals.name: owner-named-points-two-sessions
evals.prompt: Screenshot: two Claude Code sessions side by side. Left is my AI Leela agent pipeline redesign, right is a beta-reader skill for my novel. I want a genuine peek behind the scenes, not marketing. People should notice: I run multiple projects in parallel, the agent's logic on the Leela pivot, my own prompt 'This came to the mind, should we keep...' showing I steer it, and that an agent acts as a simulated coherent reader catching discrepancies. Video with audio plus captions for Insta, X and LinkedIn.
evals.expected_output: One beat per named point in the owner's order, the owner's prompt quoted verbatim, calm energy, recap card with four pins, captions per platform.
assertions: the four owner-named points each get a beat, in the owner's order, with at most one extra flagged as a suggestion
the owner's prompt appears verbatim (trimmed only with an ellipsis)
energy is calm or lively, not punchy
recap card pins match the beats
the skill does not re-ask which points to show

evals.name: portrait-phone-screenshot
evals.prompt: This is a phone screenshot of my Claude app chat where it planned my whole week of workouts around my shifts. Quietly proud of this one. Can you make something I can post on Instagram and LinkedIn?
evals.expected_output: A calm package; the portrait shot uses the overlay layout for statement and close; privacy pass flags personal details.
assertions: energy is calm with a calm or reflective music mood
statement and close use the overlay layout because the screenshot is portrait
the hand-over flags any personal details visible (names, schedule specifics) before posting
only Instagram and LinkedIn instructions are emphasised, X is optional

_comment: Inputs for evals 2 and 3 are not in the repo (they show private work). Drop your own screenshots at those paths to run them.
